packageRules.description: Batch every non-major update (npm, docker, github-actions) into a single PR so we never see more than one routine dependency PR at a time.
Release-gated @pome-sh/* pins (cli + packages). Renovate must not bump them from npm.
Known-risky majors — keep on current major until an intentional human PR (TS ≥6, Linear SDK 55→89, GraphQL 17).
Publish job stays on setup-node v6 (OIDC npmrc / ENEEDAUTH). Do not major-bump remaining v6 pins. See sdk-publish.yml and actions/setup-node#1551.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security fixes are not held for the fortnightly window.
